name: dsh-plugin-development
title_zh: 从零搭一个 DeepSeek Harness Cor
tagline_zh: 模板、规划、脚手架、实现、画像、测试、发布就绪——一条龙。别家只给代码骨架，它连发布前检查都替你排好。
tagline_en: From template to release-ready: planning, scaffolding, implementation, profile, testing, and go-live checks in.
desc_en: Use when creating or extending a standalone DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin from this self-contained template and coordinating planning, scaffolding, implementation, profile composition, testing, and release readiness. Do not use for SDK DSL-only projects or host-source changes.
why_zh: 它把插件生命周期固化成一条显式流水线，每一步都有产物和验收点，不是零散脚本。规划与实现同源。
why_en: It hardens the plugin lifecycle into one explicit pipeline with artifacts and checkpoints per stage—not scattered scripts.
limit_zh: 只认 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件模板；SDK DSL 纯脚本或改宿主源码的项目它不碰。
limit_en: Only for DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugins from this template; no SDK DSL-only or host-source changes. Release checks cover template fields only.
